name: full-scan-matrix-export-drop
body: Limit: the full-scan matrix drops the branch's seeded export before authoring, simultaneously forcing NoPreviousExport and letting Module/File be declared planned although the crate/file already exist; a fixture that must pin authoring-time acceptance against a live branch DB can only declare Struct/Function at absent FQNs. Upgrade when a test needs to pin authoring acceptance rather than realization.
